title: Greatest Common Divisor Traversal
summary: Treat every array position as a vertex.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–100000 values in [1,100000]. Equal values can occur at separate positions.
contractDetails.output-checking: Compare whether the implicit undirected graph of original positions is connected under gcd>1 adjacency.

statement: Treat every array position as a vertex. Two different vertices are connected directly when their values share a divisor greater than one. Decide whether every pair of vertices can reach one another through a sequence of such connections.

examples.explanation: 10 connects 6 through factor 2 and 35 through factor 5.
No pair shares a prime factor.
There is no distinct pair to disconnect.

constraints: 1–100000 values in [1,100000]. Equal values can occur at separate positions.
hints: Conceptual: A shared prime factor is enough to connect two positions.
Directional: Factor the values and track one earlier position for each prime.
Implementation: Union all indices sharing a prime factor, then check whether every index has the same representative. A single position is connected by itself.

expectedComplexity.time: O(M log log M + n log M × α(n)
expectedComplexity.space: O(M log log M + n log M × α(n)

complexityAnalysis: O(M log log M + n log M × α(n)) time and O(M+n) auxiliary space, where M is the largest value, using a factor sieve and union-find.
